# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. 60 of the 207 bin/ executables measured on 2026-11-01 were named in no register but a rename map, so retiring or
# renaming one started with a search. One row per file, held both ways by bin/standard-inventory.sh (standard.script-registered): a
# file with no row is red, a row with no file is red.
# WHAT IS NOT HERE. The callers of a file (hook, schedule, CI, rule, verb, justfile, another script, shim) come from the tree at the
# moment of asking (sh bin/standard-inventory.sh callers), the family is the file name's first word (name.family) and the control it
# engines is controls.tsv's engine column: stored copies of those drift while reading correctly. A file nothing calls is reported as a
# retirement proposal by check.script-uncalled, never deleted. The harbor verb table of contracts/cli.md is contracts/verbs.tsv.
# COLUMNS  path <TAB> form <TAB> layer <TAB> purpose <TAB> ticket
#   form     command (run by name or path) | library (sourced, never run) | helper (a data or text helper another file feeds)
#   layer    the language layer of CLAUDE.md's "Language by layer": floor (POSIX sh, awk and the extensionless sh shims) | trio (Python) |
#            tool (TypeScript, and the .mjs that runs beside it). The checker holds it to the file's own extension, so it cannot drift (harbor#1432)
#   purpose  what the file does, in one line
#   ticket   the first harbor issue its header cites; - when it cites none

the one managed PreToolUse entry on a member laptop: runs the guards in wiring order and decides the call once, failing closed
closes what member-dispatch.sh opened: an ask's outcome, an approval spent once the call has run

`harbor hub project register` on a member laptop: lays down AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, the tests layout and the standard note from the kit, never overwriting, writing no governance marker (control member.standard)
the Stop check member.upgrade: a worked answer without an Upgrade line, or a deciding one without a second agent, goes back once
a member's own skills, agents and commands synced with their private repo: pull at session start, push at Stop, propose a skill to the hub; bounded, fail-open
the admin side of members' personal tools, behind harbor hub tools: create a colleague's private repo, admit a proposed skill into a hub pack through the gate
the Stop check member.tests and its UserPromptSubmit snapshot: a registered project's code changed in a turn with no test goes back once
hashes the managed root and managed settings against the pin IT wrote
the one root helper a member may run: installs the fixed list in contracts/member-prereqs.txt and refuses everything else

starts one MCP server with a colleague key in its environment only, from the managed MCP file: refuses unless the policy connectors.json lists this ref with exactly this server, which no user can write; the agent calls the server tools and never holds the key

the person side of a connector: enters its key in a terminal of their own (hidden, never argv, refused inside a Claude Code session and for any ref the policy does not list) and lists which keys are stored
the board's reading code: what makes a comment count, the policy read, the relay and agent checks; shared by approval and support
a person on a member laptop asks an admin for help and watches: board request, verified accept, a time-limited upterm session
the dispatcher's rule that an agent's tool call never starts or reaches a support session
the admin side of remote support, behind harbor hub support: list, accept with the admin's gh, join with the admin's key
raises the hub policy pin on a branch and stops before signing; refuses a pin not on core main, a dirty hub, a contract change
rebuilds every person's setup script, hash and zip at a pin from a private roster, with the pin's own member-windows.sh
